title: Sources: Moonshot AI hit a $35B valuation after closing a $3.5B round, exceeding its initial target of $1B to $2B, and plans a Hong Kong IPO as soon as 2026 (Bloomberg)
commentary: Moonshot AI raised 3x its target, hit a $35B valuation, and is eyeing a Hong Kong IPO this year — China's answer to the OpenAI funding arms race is running on a similar script, just with a different stock exchange at the end.
